latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of text-to-video-kostenlos — Convert Text into Shareable Videos

- Instantly convert a text prompt into a 1080p MP4 video, ready to download in 1–2 minutes with no local installation required.
- Fully automated cloud setup: handles NEMO_TOKEN authentication and session management seamlessly for first-time users.
- Simple chat-based commands for generating videos, checking credits, uploading media, and exporting final results.
- Supports rich input types (text, images, audio) and handles common file formats up to 200MB.
- Includes robust error and rate-limit handling with clear user guidance.
- Optimized for quick, iterative edits and easy batch video creation.
